messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07. [decision; valid 2025-05-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-07]
- The product catalog deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-09-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-03]
    earlier: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to 2025-09-03; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-17]
- As of 2026-03-02, Oskar Lind is on the Ember team's on-call rotation. [valid 2026-03-02 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team's on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-03-02; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]

Question: On what date did INC-2025-023 happen?
